run.as_of_date_role_zh: 本次桌面推演的运行日（北京时间日历日）。基准的 review_due 判据以 compare_against: run.as_of_date 指定本字段为比较基准，校验实现不得改取系统时钟——同一份样例在任何一天复跑都必须得到同一判定，判定才是可复核的。
run.as_of_date_role_en: The run date of this tabletop replay (a Beijing-time calendar day). The baseline's review_due criterion names this field as its basis through compare_against: run.as_of_date, and no checker may substitute the system clock — the same fixtures must yield the same verdicts on whatever day they are replayed, which is what makes a verdict re-checkable.
run.no_measurement_note_zh: 运行声明只含一个日历日，不含任何测量读数；本块的存在不改变 contains_no_measurement_values 的承诺。
run.no_measurement_note_en: The run declaration holds one calendar day and no measurement reading; its presence leaves the contains_no_measurement_values promise untouched.

v0_2_note_zh: 随基准 v0.2 增补两条样例，用于检验本次三项闭合是否真的可执行：TT-P5 检验分母完整性规则的排除侧，声明一项文件完整性型指标而不声明任何参与者类别，应当通过；TT-N7 检验适用侧的扩张，人工接管响应耗时删除技术故障样本，应当被拒——这一条在 v0.1 的文字推导下会被漏判。原十条样例的预期判定与理由一字未改，用以确认闭合没有改变既有判据的结论。
v0_2_note_en: Two fixtures arrive with baseline v0.2 to test whether the three closures are genuinely executable. TT-P5 tests the exclusion side of denominator integrity: it declares a file-completeness metric and no participant category, and should pass. TT-N7 tests the widened scope: a human-handover response-time record that drops technical-fault samples, which should be refused, and which the v0.1 wording heuristic would have missed. The expected verdicts and reasons of the original ten fixtures are unchanged to the letter, confirming that the closures altered no existing ruling.
v0_4_note_zh: 随基准 v0.4.0 迁移与扩充。迁移：基准把生命周期字段组按申报等级设为必填，因此原二十条样例中凡申报 L1 及以上者补齐 funding_owner（十条：TT-P2、TT-P3、TT-P4、TT-N1 至 TT-N7），其余十条申报 L0 或未申报等级，触发等级未到，字段可缺席且不违例，一字未改。二十条样例的既有文字字段与期望判定全部保持原样，用以确认本次扩充没有改变任何既有结论；原样例中没有申报 L4 的条目，因此 L4 拆分为 L4a 与 L4b 未触及任何既有样例。扩充：新增二十条样例覆盖十四个新违例码的正反两侧，并覆盖 L4a 三项就绪证据、L4b 复审到期日与 AI 权限边界的精确匹配边界。测量声明类判据的表达纪律与既有分母表达一致——只声明「条件是否满足」「方向是好是坏」「结论写成什么」，不出现任何计数、比例或耗时，因此 contains_no_measurement_values 在扩充后仍然成立。
v0_4_note_en: Migrated and extended with baseline v0.4.0. Migration: the baseline makes the lifecycle field group required as a function of the claimed level, so the ten of the original twenty fixtures claiming L1 or above gain funding_owner (TT-P2, TT-P3, TT-P4 and TT-N1 through TT-N7); the other ten claim L0 or claim no level at all, sit below the triggering level, may leave the fields absent without violating, and are untouched. Every existing text field and every expected verdict of the twenty is left as it stood, confirming that the extension changed no existing ruling; none of them claimed L4, so the split of L4 into L4a and L4b touches no existing fixture. Extension: twenty fixtures cover both sides of the fourteen new violation codes, plus the three L4a readiness evidences, the L4b review expiry and the exact-match boundary of the AI authority component. The measurement-claim fixtures keep the same expression discipline the denominators already used — they declare only whether a condition held, whether a direction was good or bad, and what a conclusion was written as, with no count, no ratio and no duration, so contains_no_measurement_values still holds after the extension.
disclaimer_zh: 本文件是桌面推演样例，不是测试记录。样例中没有任何参与者、任何现场、任何计数或比例；分母只以类别是否被声明的方式表达，不带样本数量。运行本文件不产生绩效指标数值，metrics.json 中的七项包容性指标保持 unknown。
disclaimer_en: This file holds tabletop fixtures, not test records. It contains no participant, no site, no count and no ratio; denominators are expressed only as whether a category was declared, never as a sample size. Running it produces no performance metric value, and the seven inclusion metrics in metrics.json stay unknown.

verdict_semantics.accept: 五个基准组件逐项通过，该样例可以进入下一步；不表示服务已达标。
verdict_semantics.reject: 至少一个基准组件被违反，该样例在桌面阶段即被拒绝，理由逐条给出。

expected_counts_note_zh: 本样例集的条目总数与正反两侧计数在此声明；校验器读入后与本轮实跑条目数逐项比对，不等或条目数为零即以退出码 2 拒绝整次运行。此前样例集少一条与全部通过在输出上不可区分，声明总数把「跑了多少条」变成可被机器复核的读数。
expected_counts_note_en: The item total and the two polarity counts of this fixture set are declared here; the checker reads them and compares them item by item against what it actually ran, refusing the whole run at exit code 2 on any mismatch or on an empty set. Previously one fixture fewer and all fixtures passing were indistinguishable in the output, and declaring the total turns how many items ran into a figure a machine can re-check.

v0_5_note_zh: 随基准 v0.5.0 扩充二十条，样例总数由四十条增至六十条；原四十条样例的字段与期望判定一字未改，用以确认第六组件的加入没有改变任何既有结论——第六组件的全部判定码以 handover_ledger 块为触发输入，未声明该块的四十条既有样例结构性不触发。新增前十条（HL-P1 至 HL-P10）是十个 OP 节点各一条的双联交接实例：节点五个必填字段逐字取自 geometry/constraints.geojson 的同名点位并经来源对齐判据比对，申报等级与该节点既有闸门的 gate_binding 一致，交接台账各字段的推出来源逐条登记在 handover_ledger.provenance 中。OP-04 一条按其既有 ai_off_continuity_status（premise_unproven_pending_site_audit）如实登记为暂缓在岗态，不写成正常可交接：暂缓不是违例，而是前提未证时判据要求的诚实状态。后十条（HL-N1 至 HL-N10）是风险注入变体，每条以对应基线为底只改一处判据输入，检验 risk.json 中一条风险的违例情形，并在 injected_risk_pause_threshold 字段逐字引用该风险的停止条件。十条覆盖 R-01 至 R-08 与 R-11、R-12；未注入的两条如实登记原因：R-09 反向等价失效的判定需要成对读数，本样例集不含任何读数，无法在桌面阶段构造；R-10 条件差别的违例码 EQUIVALENCE_CONDITION_UNMET 已由既有的 TT-N21 与 TT-N22 两条覆盖，不重复构造。第六组件的九个判定码在本轮全部取得正反两侧覆盖：反例一侧由 HL-N1 至 HL-N9 逐码承担，正例一侧由十条基线承担；HL-N10 检验的 REVIEW_OVERDUE 属既有码。新增二十条与既有样例采用同一表达纪律：未决项只声明有无、不声明条数，署名只声明是否发生、不登记任何个人身份信息，因此 contains_no_measurement_values 在扩充后仍然成立。
v0_5_note_en: Twenty fixtures arrive with baseline v0.5.0, taking the set from forty to sixty; not a word of the original forty changed, confirming that the sixth component altered no existing ruling — every code of that component triggers on the handover_ledger block, which the forty existing fixtures do not declare and therefore do not engage. The first ten new fixtures (HL-P1 to HL-P10) are one two-part handover instance per OP node: the five required fields are verbatim from the same-named feature in geometry/constraints.geojson and are compared by the source-alignment criterion, the claimed level agrees with the gate_binding of the node's existing gate, and the derivation of every ledger field is registered item by item in handover_ledger.provenance. The OP-04 instance is registered truthfully as a hold with someone on duty, per its existing ai_off_continuity_status (premise_unproven_pending_site_audit), and never as a normal completed handover: a hold is no violation but the honest state the criteria require where a premise is unproven. The last ten (HL-N1 to HL-N10) are risk-injection variants, each taking its baseline and altering exactly one criterion input to test one violating situation from risk.json, quoting that risk's stop condition verbatim in the injected_risk_pause_threshold field. The ten cover R-01 to R-08 plus R-11 and R-12; the two not injected are registered with their reasons: R-09, reverse equivalence failure, needs paired readings and this set holds none, so it cannot be constructed at the tabletop stage; and R-10, differential terms, already has both its sides covered by TT-N21 and TT-N22 through EQUIVALENCE_CONDITION_UNMET, so it is not duplicated. All nine codes of the sixth component gain coverage on both sides in this round: the negative side is carried code by code by HL-N1 to HL-N9 and the positive side by the ten baselines, while the REVIEW_OVERDUE tested by HL-N10 is an existing code. The twenty new fixtures keep the same expression discipline as the existing set: open items declare presence and never a count, signatures declare that signing occurred and record no personal identifying data, so contains_no_measurement_values still holds after the extension.
